channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Congress Avoids Government Shutdown Ahead of Midterms
item.description: The House passed a funding extension through mid-December, preventing a shutdown just weeks before elections.

item.title: Homes Near Sufi Shrine Demolished, Displacing Residents
item.description: In a pilgrimage neighborhood, hundreds of homes belonging to the working poor have been demolished over the past year.

item.title: Wendell Berry, acclaimed author and environmental advocate, passes away at 92
item.description: Wendell Berry, a renowned American poet, novelist, essayist, and farmer, has died at age 92.

item.title: ICE now equipped with body cameras following series of fatal incidents
item.description: The move may address transparency and accountability concerns after immigration officers were involved in more than two dozen shootings.
